description: The agent descriptor tzun-agent/1 (Record §6.9): its canonical bytes and digest with every set sorted by UTF-8 bytes, its grammar and the limits a writer applies when it registers one, and the decider kind it contradicts (Record §6.4).
source: Generated by scripts/generate-agent-descriptor-vectors.ts. Every expected answer is written in the script from the specification, and the script stops if the engine disagrees with one. A violations case with grammar true and writer false is a descriptor a store-level verifier re-hashes as stored and a writer refuses to register. LONE_SURROGATE_D800 stands for an unpaired U+D800; a harness substitutes it before it checks.
